svg.text: PLC I/O card wiring – station HMC01, cabinet +CAB01 (addresses and terminals = I/O list 11.12)
24 V DC PELV, sinking DI for PNP sensors, sourcing (PNP) DQ 0.5 A, AI 4–20 mA 2-wire. Wire colours: 24 V+ dark blue, 0 V blue-white (company rule, chapter 11.3).
PNP sensor switches +24 V to the input; card input current flows to M inside the module.
Wire break or sensor off → input = 0. Pins M12: 1 BN +24 V · 3 BU 0 V · 4 BK signal.
DQ switches +24 V to the load (PNP / sourcing),
the load returns to M. Coils: diode (or varistor)
across the coil; a pure diode makes drop-out slower.
-KF10 interposing relay: its contact switches the
230 V coil of pump contactor -QA5 (other page).
%Q20.5 = spare channel, used here as an example.
Loop: L+ → transmitter + … − → AI input → module
Shielded pair, shield on the cabinet EMC rail only.
• -FC2/-FC3/-FC4: electronic circuit breakers per group – a sensor short does not stop the CPU (chapter 11.2).
• Terminals -XD2: DI 1–20, DQ 21–40, AI 41–60 (proposal 12.3). Field cables end on terminals, not on modules.
• Safety signals (E-stop, door, light curtain) are NOT on these cards: F-DI/F-DQ on -XD3 (see guide 24 drawing 24_io_wiring).
• Wire numbers page.column (23.1 …) as in chapter 12.3. Values = examples.
M 0 V (connected to PE at one point – PELV)
PNP sensors, valve with diode, relay, lamp, 2-wire 4–20 mA
